program.title: BSc in Computer Science
uncertain: The 'Engineering Fundamental Course(s)' and 'Required Course(s)' groups have 'Credit(s) attained' values in the PDF (e.g., 3, 4-7, 5-8, etc.), but these appear to be per-course or per-option credits, not group totals. No explicit group total credits are stated in the PDF for these groups, so required_credits is set to 0 as per instruction to use 0 if not stated. The 'Elective(s)' group has an explicit minimum of 18 credits, so it is correctly set.

The note for the first row in 'Engineering Fundamental Course(s)' (COMP 1021 OR COMP 1022P) and similar OR/AND notes in MATH rows are not captured in the group's 'note' field as per rule 4. These should be attached to the group note, and the mentioned courses should be listed as course entries. However, the courses are already listed individually, so the main missing piece is aggregating these notes into the group note.
The note for the first row in 'Required Course(s)' ((COMP 2011 AND COMP 2012) OR COMP 2012H) and similar OR notes are not captured in the group's 'note' field.
It is unclear whether courses like COMP 4900 with 0 credits should be included; they are included as they appear in the text.

The 'Elective(s)' group has no specific courses listed in the provided text, only a description. If courses are meant to be inferred from context (e.g., COMP 2000-level or above), they are not explicitly listed, so no courses are included.

total_required_credits (18.0) is a computed value: the sum of the required_credits of all groups in this file. The PDF does not state a single overall minimum total for this program, so this figure is derived by summation and may double-count where optional tracks/options are listed as separate groups.
